high_level_description: The image features a person sitting on the floor against a plain, muted green backdrop. The individual is dressed in a black tracksuit with white stripes running down the sleeves and legs. The tracksuit has a high collar and appears to be made of a textured fabric. The person is wearing white sneakers with black accents, which match the color scheme of the tracksuit. The person's pose is relaxed yet confident; they are sitting with one leg bent and the other extended, resting their hand on their chin. Their hair is curly and voluminous, cascading over their shoulders.
